title: A novel SaeS-targeting antivirulence antagonist screened against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.
authors: Yao, Jiahao; Ai, Duiyuan; Duan, Huanhuan
journal: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
one_liner_zh: 该文针对金黄色葡萄球菌SaeS激酶进行虚拟筛选与分子模拟，对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴，与课题关联度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The SaeRS two-component system is a major virulence regulator in Staphylococcus aureus, and its sensor kinase SaeS represents a potential target for small-molecule intervention. METHODS: In this study, we constructed a library of 1,093 compounds from PubChem and carried out structure-guided virtual screening against the SaeS kinase domain. This approach identified an amide-based candidate, designated Saeamid-1. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations supported stable binding of Saeamid-1 within the nucleotide-binding region of SaeS, with a docking score of -9.884 kcal/mol. RESULTS: The compound had only limited effects on bacterial growth. In contrast, it reduced hemolytic activity and biofilm biomass in USA300 by 65.74% and 88.77%, respectively. RT-qPCR analysis showed that Saeamid-1 reduced the expression of saeR, saeS, and the SaeRS-associated virulence gene spa. CONCLUSIONS: Taken together, these findings identify Saeamid-1 as a promising antivirulence candidate that targets SaeS in methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus and provide a basis for further development of therapeutic strategies directed against the SaeRS pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：SaeRS双组分系统是金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus）的主要毒力调节因子，其传感器激酶SaeS代表了小分子干预的潜在靶点。方法：在本研究中，我们从PubChem构建了一个包含1,093种化合物的库，并针对SaeS激酶结构域进行了结构引导的虚拟筛选。该方法识别出一种基于酰胺的候选化合物，命名为Saeamid-1。分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟支持Saeamid-1在SaeS核苷酸结合区域内的稳定结合，对接评分为-9.884 kcal/mol。结果：该化合物对细菌生长仅有有限影响。相反，它使USA300中的溶血活性和生物膜生物量分别降低了65.74%和88.77%。RT-qPCR分析显示，Saeamid-1降低了saeR、saeS以及SaeRS相关毒力基因spa的表达。结论：综合来看，这些发现将Saeamid-1确定为一种针对耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus）中SaeS的有前景的抗毒力候选物，并为针对SaeRS通路的治疗策略进一步开发提供了基础。
